title: Solid Square
description:
Given an integer n, print a solid square of asterisks (*) with n rows and n columns. Stars are printed side by side with no spaces between them.

Input

A single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 20).

Output

Print n lines, each containing n asterisks.

Example for input 4:

****
****
****
****

title: Hollow Square
description:
Given an integer n, print a hollow square of size n x n. Only the border is made of asterisks (*); the inside is filled with spaces.

Input

A single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 20).

Output

Print n lines forming the hollow square. Do not print any trailing spaces.

Example for input 4:

****
*  *
*  *
****

title: X Marks the Spot
description:
Given an odd integer n, print an X shape of asterisks inside an n x n grid. Position (i, j) (0-based) holds a star when it lies on either diagonal, i.e. j == i or j == n - 1 - i; every other position is a space.

Input

A single odd integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 21).

Output

Print n lines forming the X. Do not print any trailing spaces.

Example for input 5:

*   *
 * *
  *
 * *
*   *
solution:
n = int(input())
for i in range(n):
    row = "".join("*" if j == i or j == n - 1 - i else " " for j in range(n))
    print(row.rstrip())

title: Checkerboard
description:
Given an integer n, print an n x n checkerboard using the characters # and . (no spaces). The top-left cell is #, and the characters alternate both across each row and down each column: cell (i, j) (0-based) is # when i + j is even, otherwise ..

Input

A single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 20).

Output

Print n lines, each containing n characters.

Example for input 4:

.#.#
#.#.
.#.#

title: Butterfly
description:
Given an integer n, print a butterfly pattern with 2n - 1 rows. In the top half, row i (1 to n) consists of i stars, then 2(n - i) spaces, then i stars, so the two wings meet in row n as 2n stars. The bottom half mirrors the top half (rows n - 1 down to 1).

Input

A single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 20).

Output

Print 2n - 1 lines forming the butterfly.

*      *
